selection.edition: international Wrike REST API v4 at www.wrike.com
selection.ownership: Wrike, Inc. (Citrix / Cloud Software Group). Reviewed edition is the international REST API v4 at www.wrike.com/api/v4, not a mainland-China product.

research.searchCoverage: Official Wrike API v4 (Bearer permanent access token or OAuth, GET /contacts?me=true, GET /folders, GET /tasks, POST query-parameter writes), webhook event types, work schedules, request forms, cascading fields, batch operations, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-10-10. Host is bounded www.wrike.com. DataHub and Cloud Content Connector use different hosts and stay out of this edition. This is not a breach-free claim.
